text: Surgery is an important branch in the field of medicine. It mainly studies the theories and techniques of treating diseases through surgery and other invasive operations, covering the diagnosis, treatment and perioperative management of various surgical diseases such as trauma, tumors, malformations and infections. This major is based on anatomy, pathology, pathophysiology, etc., emphasizing the combination of practical operation and clinical thinking, and aims to cultivate clinical surgeons who possess the ability to diagnose and treat surgical diseases, surgical operation skills, and doctor-patient communication skills.
